standards_review.notes:
Pre-existing XSS regression tests were dropped alongside the new toaster suite; announcer forwards raw text with
tokens to live region (screen reader hears literal tag)

findings.problem: Pre-existing 'toaster XSS prevention' describe block was deleted when the file was rewritten to add the announcer suite. That block covered prepareText() sanitisation of
findings.impact: Security regression coverage lost — a future change to prepareText or the Toastify call chain could silently break sanitisation with no failing test to catch it.
findings.recommendation: Restore the two XSS tests inside a separate describe block alongside the new announcer describe.

findings.problem: useEffect cleanup unconditionally calls setToasterAnnouncer(null). If two ToasterAnnouncer instances briefly coexist (HMR hot-swap, accidental double mount), the first one's unmount evicts the second's registration.
findings.impact: In HMR sessions every toast is silently swallowed during the hot-reload window; a future double-mount would silently disable announcements entirely.
findings.recommendation: Add an `expected` parameter to setToasterAnnouncer that only clears when the current slot value matches; pass `announce` from the cleanup so a stale unmount is a no-op.

findings.problem:
announcer?.(text) forwards the raw text argument, including the

' string.
findings.impact:
UX degradation for every multi-part status/error message using the header/content
convention (documented pattern throughout the app).
findings.recommendation:
Add a toAnnouncement helper that strips
and any residual tags before invoking announcer.

rationale:
Three-lens fan-out (blind + edge-case + acceptance) on 415-line diff. Blind and acceptance converge on the dropped XSS test suite (CR-001). Edge-case surfaces the unconditional cleanup race (CR-002) and the literal-
screen-reader UX regression (CR-003). All three are actionable, small, non-speculative. Zero dismissed findings; zero deferred. Full unit suite (4689 tests) plus the new 9 announcer tests all green pre-fix. Findings block approve; fixes follow in check round.
